Resolve a named performance-metric year window

Source: R/performance_metrics.R
PM_Window_Years.Rd

Resolves `window` to a vector of projection years to pass as the `Years` argument of an [MSEtool::PM] function, always first restricted to years on/after `MPStartYear` via [PM_Years()]. [MSEtool::PM] functions apply that floor themselves when `Years = NULL` (see [PM_Years()]), but have no equivalent for the named windows below, so this function remains the way to get those.

Usage

PM_Window_Years(
  object,
  window = c("all", "last10", "short", "medium", "long", "terminal")
)

Arguments

object

An `mse`/`hist`/`om` object.

window

Character. One of `"all"` (every year from `MPStartYear` onwards), `"last10"` (the final 10 of those years), `"short"` (the first 10), `"medium"` (everything between `"short"` and `"long"`), `"long"` (the final 10), or `"terminal"` (the final year only).

Value

Numeric vector of years.

Details

`"short"`/`"medium"`/`"long"` split the full active-year range into three consecutive, non-overlapping chunks – the first 10 years, the last 10 years, and the middle 10 when there are 30 active years.
